verses.text: Jesus said to him, “I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father, except through me.”

The LORD is my shepherd; I shall lack nothing. He makes me lie down in green pastures. He leads me beside still waters. He restores my soul. He guides me in the paths of righteousness for his name’s sake.

Which of you men, if you had one hundred sheep and lost one of them, wouldn’t leave the ninety-nine in the wilderness and go after the one that was lost, until he found it? When he has found it, he carries it on his shoulders, rejoicing. When he comes home, he calls together his friends and his neighbours, saying to them, ‘Rejoice with me, for I have found my sheep which was lost!’
For the Son of Man came to seek and to save that which was lost.
Trust in the LORD with all your heart, and don’t lean on your own understanding. In all your ways acknowledge him, and he will make your paths straight.
I will instruct you and teach you in the way which you shall go. I will counsel you with my eye on you.
Your word is a lamp to my feet, and a light for my path.
And when you turn to the right hand, and when you turn to the left, your ears will hear a voice behind you, saying, “This is the way. Walk in it.”

I will bring the blind by a way that they don’t know. I will lead them in paths that they don’t know. I will make darkness light before them, and crooked places straight. I will do these things, and I will not forsake them.
And the LORD will guide you continually, satisfy your soul in dry places, and make your bones strong. You will be like a watered garden, and like a spring of water whose waters don’t fail.
You shall call on me, and you shall go and pray to me, and I will listen to you. You shall seek me and find me, when you search for me with all your heart.
Call to me, and I will answer you, and will show you great and difficult things, which you don’t know.
Ask, and it will be given you. Seek, and you will find. Knock, and it will be opened for you. For everyone who asks receives. He who seeks finds. To him who knocks it will be opened.
Come to me, all you who labour and are heavily burdened, and I will give you rest.
Again, therefore, Jesus spoke to them, saying, “I am the light of the world. He who follows me will not walk in the darkness, but will have the light of life.”
I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep.
My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me. I give eternal life to them. They will never perish, and no one will snatch them out of my hand.
Show me your ways, LORD. Teach me your paths. Guide me in your truth, and teach me, For you are the God of my salvation. I wait for you all day long.
You will show me the path of life. In your presence is fullness of joy. In your right hand there are pleasures forever more.
A man’s steps are established by the LORD. He delights in his way. Though he stumble, he shall not fall, for the LORD holds him up with his hand.
For this God is our God forever and ever. He will be our guide even to death.
Nevertheless, I am continually with you. You have held my right hand. You will guide me with your counsel, and afterward receive me to glory.
If I take the wings of the dawn, and settle in the uttermost parts of the sea, even there your hand will lead me, and your right hand will hold me.
Cause me to hear your loving kindness in the morning, for I trust in you. Cause me to know the way in which I should walk, for I lift up my soul to you.
Teach me to do your will, for you are my God. Your Spirit is good. Lead me in the land of uprightness.
Commit your deeds to the LORD, and your plans shall succeed.
A man’s heart plans his course, but the LORD directs his steps.
Don’t you be afraid, for I am with you. Don’t be dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you. Yes, I will help you. Yes, I will uphold you with the right hand of my righteousness.
But now the LORD who created you, Jacob, and he who formed you, Israel, says: “Don’t be afraid, for I have redeemed you. I have called you by your name. You are mine.”
The LORD, your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel, says: “I am the LORD your God, who teaches you to profit, who leads you by the way that you should go.”

“I will seek that which was lost, and will bring back that which was driven away, and will bind up that which was broken, and will strengthen that which was sick; but I will destroy the fat and the strong. I will feed them in justice.”’
He arose and came to his father. But while he was still far off, his father saw him and was moved with compassion, and ran, fell on his neck, and kissed him.
For this, my son, was dead and is alive again. He was lost and is found.’ Then they began to celebrate.
But if any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask of God, who gives to all liberally and without reproach, and it will be given to him.
Draw near to God, and he will draw near to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners. Purify your hearts, you double-minded.
Don’t be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind, so that you may prove what is the good, well-pleasing, and perfect will of God.
For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared before that we would walk in them.
Being confident of this very thing, that he who began a good work in you will complete it until the day of Jesus Christ.
And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to which also you were called in one body, and be thankful.
Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, today, and forever.
Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid or scared of them, for the LORD your God himself is who goes with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you.
Haven’t I commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid. Don’t be dismayed, for the LORD your God is with you wherever you go.
If we confess our sins, he is faithful and righteous to forgive us the sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
Behold, I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, then I will come in to him and will dine with him, and he with me.
He has shown you, O man, what is good. What does the LORD require of you, but to act justly, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with your God?
Teach me your way, LORD. Lead me in a straight path, because of my enemies.
For you are my rock and my fortress, therefore for your name’s sake lead me and guide me.
He will feed his flock like a shepherd. He will gather the lambs in his arm, and carry them in his bosom. He will gently lead those who have their young.
The LORD says, “Stand in the ways and see, and ask for the old paths, ‘Where is the good way?’ and walk in it, and you will find rest for your souls. But they said, ‘We will not walk in it.’”
He will guide the humble in justice. He will teach the humble his way.

messages.text: Bw'owulira nga wabuze, jjukira nti Omusumba Omulungi aleka endiga ekyenda mu mwenda okukuza.
Tolina kwetaaga kumanya kkubo lyonna. Kyokka ky'olina okukola kwe kutambula n'omutendera oguddako ne Yesu.
Yesu yagamba nti, Nze kkubo. Bw'oba nga tomanyi kkubo lyo, mukwatireko.
Okuwulira ng'obuze kye kisooka okukuyamba okufuna obulagirizi.
Jjangu ewaka. Kitaawe ali dda ng'adduka okukusisinkana, nga kitaawe w'omwana omubbi.
Tuula mu kasirise okumala eddakiika ntono obuuze, Mukama, kiki ky'oyagala nkole leero?
Ekigambo kya Katonda kitabaaza ebigere byo. Ggulawo Enjiri ekuyambe okutegeera ekkubo ly'oyitamu.
Oyinza obutamanya gy'olaga, naye omanyi ani agenda naawe.
Ssakalamentu ly'okwenenya liri oluggi oludda ewaka. Bulijjo libeera nga liggule.
Katonda yakukola n'ekigendererwa era n'olw'ekigendererwa. Mubuuze akulage kye kiri.
Bw'oba nga tomanyi ky'oyinza kusaba, saba Our Father. Yesu yagiyigiriza mu biseera ng'ebyo.
Okubulwa tekitegeeza kwerabirwa. Katonda amanyi bulungi gy'oli.
Noonya Mukama era ojja kumuzuula bw'omunoonyeza n'omutima gwo gwonna.
Yogera ne kabona oba mukwano gw'omuntu omugezi. Katonda atukulembera emirundi mingi ng'ayita mu bantu abalala.
Abagezi baagoberera emmunyeenye mu kizikiza. Katonda ajja kuwa ekitangaala ekimala olugendo lwo.
Saint Augustine yanoonya buli wamu okufuna essanyu okutuusa lwe yalifuna mu Katonda. Emitima gyaffe tegisobola kuba mirembe okutuusa lwe giba nga gigenda mu Ye.
Toli wala nnyo. Tewali lugendo lusinga ku kwagala kwa Katonda.
Kola enteekateeka entonotono ey'olwa leero: okusaba, ekikolwa ekirungi n'okwogera eky'amazima.
Mary ayitibwa Star of the Sea. Mubuuze akulage ekkubo erikukulembera ewa mutabani we.
Katonda talaga mmaapu yonna, naye asuubiza okutambula buli mayiro naawe.
Bw'oba nga wabula, totya kuddayo. Eggulu lisanyuka olw'oyo akomawo.
Okusirika kuyamba. Ziyiza okuwulira amaloboozi ag'ebweru okumala akaseera era owulire eddoboozi lya Katonda erisirikidde.
Yesu ye y'omu eggulo, leero ne mu biseera byonna. Mu nsi ekyuka, Ye kye kyokulabirako ekigumira.
Ozuulibwa mu Kristo, ne bwe weewulira ng'obuze mu nsi.
Genda mu kkanisa leero, ne bwe kiba okumala eddakiika ttaano. Tuula mu maaso g'ekyoto era obeereyo obulungi.
Katonda ayogera ng'ayita mu kwegomba kwaffe okw'ebirungi. Kintu ki ekirungi ekiri mu mutima gwo?
Saba amagezi. Katonda agawa buli asaba.
Okubuzaabuza si kwe kukoma kw'okukkiriza. Ebiseera ebimu kwe kuba okukula kw'okukkiriza.
Omwoyo Omutukuvu ye mukulembeze wo. Saba, Jjangu Omwoyo Omutukuvu, era olindirire.
Tolina kukikola byonna leero. Weesige Katonda ku by'enkya.
Ddayo ku bintu eby'enkizo: okusaba, obukristaayo, Ekigambo kya Katonda n'okwagala muliraanwa.
Kristo akonkona ku luggi lw'omutima gwo. Kyokka weetaaga kuguggulawo.
Buli mutukuvu yali ayimiridde ku mabbali g'ekkubo. Baasalawo okugoberera Yesu, olunaku olumu ku lunaku olulala.
Katonda asobola okukyusa ekkubo ekkyamu n'akifuula ekkubo eggolokofu.
Bw'owulira ng'otabuddwa, weeyambise essaala buli lunaku, ne bwe kiba okumala eddakiika ntono.
Obutonde bwo si nsobi zo oba okubuzaabuzibwa kwo. Oli mwana wa Katonda omwagalwa.
Mukama ajja kukulungamya bulijjo era akkuse emmeeme yo.
Saba Saint Anthony akusabire. Ayamba okuzuula ebintu ebyabuze, n'emitima egibuziddwa.
Kola eby'obwenkanya, yagala ekisa era otambule n'obwetoowaze ne Katonda. Ekyo kye kifo ekirungi okutandikirako.
Katonda atuteekateeka emirimu emirungi okutambuliramu. Amukulembere mu mirimu egyo.
Ne mu ddungu, Katonda yaliisa abantu be emmaanu buli lunaku. Ajja kukulabirira.
Oli mu lugendo, tolina kuba nga obuze emirembe gyonna. Weeyongere okutambula ng'oyolekera ekitangaala.
Saba nga tonnakola kusalawo, ne bwe kuba okutono. Katonda afaayo ku buli mutendera.
Lekeera okwagala okumanya buli kimu. Okukkiriza kwe kwesiga oyo akola.
Omusaayi atwala endiga eyabula awaka ku bibegabega bye, ng'asanyuka. Bwe kityo Yesu bw'akutunuulira.
Laba emabega olabe gy'atutte. Talyekuba ku mukono kati.
Funa ekibiina ky'okukkiriza. Kyangu okuzuula ekkubo nga muli wamu.
Buli gy'ogenda, ne bw'oba ng'oyita ku nkomerero y'ensi, omukono gwa Katonda gujja kukunyweza.
Leero, twala ekintu kimu okugenda eri Katonda. Ajja kutwala ekkumi okujja gy'oli.
Wummula ekiro kino ng'omanyi nti Oyo amanyi ekkubo akutte omukono gwo.
